entries.prompt: Isolate ONLY the rigid mask and its physically attached pale bone jaw trophy from this official2021 PHG publisher screenshot. Keep the source exact near-front downward-inclined camera,slight projected asymmetry,whole crown/muzzle contour and apparent proportions. This is the source-visible Mr.Black PHG edition,not a substitute from a film,NECA or prior project reconstruction. Preserve the dark purple-gray/gunmetal metallic smooth broad oval crown with its thick raised surrounding arch and visible source wear; the swept eye/brow/cheek ridges and black opaque eye inserts; the small image-left circular temple module with EXACTLY THREE small red lenses in its source compact triangle,no emitted glow. Preserve the existing pale/beige rigid BONE JAW TROPHY fixed around the lower mask: same complete curved lower outline,source count/placement of small upright teeth and rough worn bone texture. That rigid attached bony jaw is part of this mask edition and must remain; do not remove it as wearer biology,turn it into a living jaw or replace it with generic tusks. Exclude all real wearer skin/living mandibles/neck behind and beneath the trophy,dreadlocks,metal hair rings,body/armor,shoulder weapon on image-right and scene. Do not add a full skull face,new vents,fangs,symbols,runes,holes,fittings or hidden rear/interior geometry. Preserve actual screenshot materials,apparent palette,source local light and dark source eye treatment,not a new colorway or straight-front redesign. Exactly one complete isolated hard mask+trophy,genuine transparent RGBA,centered with10percent clear transparent margin all around,crown and whole bone chin/tips unclipped,longest axis78-80percent canvas. No floor,shadow plane,background,UI,text,glow or duplicate views. Fine relief is limited by the source screenshot; this is a source-view candidate,not automatically certified exact canon geometry.

selfReview.kind: Agent review of native ImageGen output and original source; not human art validation.
selfReview.observations: Dark purple-gray/gunmetal oval crown with raised arch,black eye inserts,three red physical lenses and attached pale bone jaw trophy. Preserve whole trophy and source camera.
selfReview.exclusions: Living wearer skin/mandibles,neck,dreads,hair rings,body,armor,shoulder weapon and background.
selfReview.limits: Visible source-view geometry only; fine relief and unclear attachment ownership remain qualified.
